target_customer: Regulatory affairs teams at mid-to-large pharma and life sciences companies
problem: Regulatory teams spend large amounts of time drafting documents, checking compliance and monitoring rules for FDA approvals.
business_model: B2B SaaS AI agents sold to life sciences companies, with enterprise pilots (pricing not found)
product_category: AI agents for life sciences regulatory work

founders.name: Rishabh Arya
founders.background_notes: Named by Indian Startup News (2025-04-02); not on the YC page and reportedly not a company director, so status is disputed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Document drafting, compliance checking and monitoring for FDA workflows needs domain data and accuracy controls; LLM agents were not yet mainstream in 2022.

defensibility.rationale: Regulated workflow integration and security can lock in customers, but the AI layer is copyable and rivals like Weave Bio and Peer AI later entered.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Veeva Vault RIM is described as the dominant regulatory software; no acquisition or copy of Entvin found.

market_need_then: Regulatory submission work in pharma was labor intensive, with an established RIM software market; no 2022 dated demand source was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses entvin.com (YC link carries a utm parameter).

rebrands.why: Indian press uses 'Entvin AI'; no source describes a formal rebrand

brand_strength.rationale: No brand-specific coverage or community found; press covered the funding and IIT Bombay angle.

outcome_analysis: Entvin entered YC in Summer 2022 and by 2025 was building AI agents for pharma regulatory teams, with enterprise pilots and a reported $500K first round from Y Combinator in March to April 2025. The long gap between batch and first reported round suggests slow early traction, but no source states this. It is active and the AI regulatory category has since attracted rivals such as Weave Bio and Peer AI.
notes: Company website did not resolve. Round confirmed by Indian Startup News (2025-04-02) and Business Standard (URL dated 2025-03-28, not opened) plus other outlets; it is probably YC's standard deal reported late, and the stage is not stated so 'other'. Founder list conflicts: Rishabh Arya named by press, absent from YC page; Seedtable lists Kshitij Jain. Founding year 2021 (Entrepreneur India) vs 2022 (YC). Competitors: Veeva, IQVIA, Ennov, Freyr appear in market reports but none dated near the batch, so the list is empty; later rivals Weave Bio (founded 2022, Series A later) and Peer AI (2025). No pivot or shutdown found. Education of Arya from press only.
